I bought this ice machine about 2 years ago and it worked fine, it made ice fast but now that I have had it awhile I have several items to note,

1. The ice only taste as good as the water you fill it with, when you use filtered water, it taste great, when you use tap water, it taste terrible but that's not on the machine, that's the user.

2. It doesn't have a self cleaner so you have to lug it over to the sink to wash and scrub in those hard to reach areas that grow mildew.

3. Machine runs is loud.

4. After 2 years, for whatever reason, the plastic hood that swings over the steel posts to make the ice, snapped off and has no way to be reattached. So because of this cheap plastic, I have an ice maker with a working motor but because of a plastic part, I have to replace it. I don't see how I can replace the hood unless I figure out how to take the entire thing apart.
